components.name: WizardBasicStep
components.description: Type used to define 'basic' steps, or in other words, steps that are neither parents or children of parents.

components.name: WizardParentStep
components.description: Type used to define parent steps.

components.name: WizardSubStep
components.description: Type used to define sub-steps.

components.name: WizardStepType
components.description: Encompasses all step type variants that are internally controlled by the Wizard.

components.name: CustomWizardNavFunction
components.description: Callback for the Wizard's 'nav' property. Returns element which replaces the Wizard's default navigation.

components.name: CustomWizardNavItemFunction
components.description: Callback for the Wizard's 'navItem' property. Returns element which replaces the WizardStep's default navigation item.

components.name: CustomWizardFooterFunction
components.description: Callback for the Wizard's 'footer' property. Returns element which replaces the Wizard's default footer.

components.name: WizardToggle
components.description: Used to toggle between step content, including the body and footer. This is also where the navigation and its expandability is controlled.

components.name: WizardStep
components.description: The primary child component for Wizard. Step props are used for the list of steps managed in context.

components.name: WizardNavInternal
components.description:
Hosts default wizard navigation logic by utilizing the wizard's context and WizardNav/WizardNavItem.
This component is not exposed to consumers.

components.name: WizardBody
components.description: Used as a wrapper for WizardStep content, where the wrapping element is customizable.

components.name: Wizard
components.description:
Wrapper for all steps and hosts state, including navigation helpers, within context.
The WizardContext provided by default gives any child of wizard access to those resources.

components.name: TreeViewSearch
components.description:
Renders a search input for the tree view. This sub-component should be passed into the
tree view component's toolbar property.

components.name: TreeView
components.description: The main tree view component.

components.name: TreeViewDataItem
components.description:
Properties that make up a tree view data item. These properties should be passed in as an
object to one of the various tree view component properties which accept TreeViewDataItem as
a type.

components.name: Slider
components.description: The main slider component.

components.name: SliderStepObject
components.description:
Properties for creating custom steps in a slider. These properties should be passed in as
an object within an array to the slider component's customSteps property.

components.name: SearchInput
components.description: The main search input component.

components.name: SearchInputSearchAttribute
components.description:
Properties for adding search attributes to an advanced search input. These properties must
be passed in as an object within an array to the search input component's attribute property.

components.name: SearchInputExpandable
components.description:
Properties for creating an expandable search input. These properties should be passed into
the search input component's expandableInput property.

components.name: SelectOption
components.description: See the MenuItem section of the Menu documentation for additional props that may be passed.

components.name: SelectGroup
components.description: See the MenuGroup section of the Menu documentation for additional props that may be passed.

components.name: Select
components.description: See the Menu documentation for additional props that may be passed.

components.name: Popover
components.description:
The main popover component. The following properties can also be passed into another component
that has a property specifically for passing in popover properties.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: The main pagination component.

components.name: PerPageOptions
components.description:
Properties to customize the content and behavior of the pagination dropdown options. These
properties should be passed into the pagination component's perPageOptions property.

components.name: PaginationTitles
components.description:
Properties to customize various pagination titles. The following properties should be
passed into the pagination component's title property.

components.name: MultipleFileUploadStatusItem
components.description:
Automatically reads an uploaded file to render a visual representation of it, including
its name, size, and read status. This sub-component also allows custom reading of files
via various callbacks which will override the automatic reading behavior.

components.name: MultipleFileUploadStatus
components.description:
Acts as an expandable container for all uploaded file statuses.
An optional text and/or icon can also be passed into this sub-component.
This sub-component can be conditionally rendered when at least 1 file has been
attempted to be uploaded.

components.name: MultipleFileUploadMain
components.description:
Creates the visual upload interface, including the area to drag and drop files,
an optional upload button, and descriptive instructions.

components.name: MultipleFileUpload
components.description:
Acts as a container for all other MultipleFileUpload sub-components. This sub-component
also provides the functionality for file uploads, and access to the uploaded files via
a callback.

components.name: MenuContainer
components.description: Container that links a menu and menu toggle together, to handle basic keyboard input and control the opening and closing of a menu.

components.name: ModalHeader
components.description: Renders content in the header of the modal

components.name: ModalFooter
components.description: Renders content in the footer of the modal

components.name: ModalBody
components.description: Renders content in the body of the modal

components.name: FileUploadHelperText
components.description:
A container for helper text content. This sub-component should be passed as a child to
the main file upload or file upload field component.

components.name: FileUploadField
components.description:
A more customizable file upload component for implementing custom logic. Drag and drop
functionality is not built in by default.

components.name: ExpandableSectionToggle
components.description:
Acts as the toggle sub-component when the main expandable section component has the isDetached
property passed in. Allows for more custom control over the expandable section's toggle.

components.name: ExpandableSection
components.description: The main expandable section component.

components.name: FormGroupLabelHelp
components.description:
A help button to be passed to the FormGroup's labelHelp property. This should be wrapped or linked
to our Popover component.

components.name: DualListSelectorTree
components.description:
Used in place of the DualListSelectorListItem sub-component when building a
composable dual list selector with a tree.

components.name: DualListSelectorPane
components.description:
Acts as the container for a list of options that are either available or chosen,
depending on the pane type (available or chosen). A search input and other actions,
such as sorting, can also be passed into this sub-component.

components.name: DualListSelector
components.description:
Acts as a container for all other DualListSelector sub-components when using a
composable dual list selector.

components.name: DropdownItem
components.description: See the MenuItem section of the Menu documentation for additional props that may be passed.

components.name: DropdownGroup
components.description: See the MenuGroup section of the Menu documentation for additional props that may be passed.

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: See the Menu documentation for additional props that may be passed.

components.name: DrawerPanelDescription
components.description: Provides a description within the drawer panel. This should typically follow the drawer head.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: The main date picker component.

components.name: DatePickerRequiredObject
components.description: Props that customize the requirement of a date

components.name: DatePickerRef
components.description:
Allows finer control over the calendar's open state when a React ref is passed into the
date picker component. Accessed via ref.current[property], e.g. ref.current.toggleCalendar().

components.name: CalendarMonth
components.description: The main calendar month component.

components.name: CalendarFormat
components.description:
Additional properties that extend from and can be passed to the main component. These
properties allow customizing the calendar formatting and aria-labels.

components.name: AlertActionLink
components.description:
Renders buttons styled as links beneath the alert title and description when this sub-component
is passed into the alert's actionLinks property.

components.name: AlertActionCloseButton
components.description:
Renders a close button for a dismissable alert when this sub-component is passed into
the alert's actionClose property.

components.name: Alert
components.description: The main alert component.

components.name: DualListSelectorTree-deprecated
components.description:
Used in place of the DualListSelectorListItem sub-component when building a
composable dual list selector with a tree.

components.name: DualListSelectorTreeProps-deprecated
components.description:
Used in place of the DualListSelectorListItem sub-component when building a
composable dual list selector with a tree.

components.name: DualListSelectorPane-deprecated
components.description:
Acts as the container for a list of options that are either available or chosen,
depending on the pane type (available or chosen). A search input and other actions,
such as sorting, can also be passed into this sub-component.

components.name: DualListSelectorPaneProps-deprecated
components.description:
Acts as the container for a list of options that are either available or chosen,
depending on the pane type (available or chosen). A search input and other actions,
such as sorting, can also be passed into this sub-component.

components.name: DualListSelectorListItemProps-deprecated
components.description:
Creates an individual option that can be selected and moved between the
dual list selector panes. This is contained within the DualListSelectorList sub-component.

components.name: DualListSelectorList-deprecated
components.description: Acts as the container for DualListSelectorListItem sub-components.

components.name: DualListSelectorListProps-deprecated
components.description: Acts as the container for DualListSelectorListItem sub-components.

components.name: DualListSelectorControlsWrapperProps-deprecated
components.description: Acts as the container for the DualListSelectorControl sub-components.

components.name: DualListSelectorControlProps-deprecated
components.description:
Renders an individual control button for moving selected options between each
dual list selector pane.

components.name: DualListSelector-deprecated
components.description:
Acts as a container for all other DualListSelector sub-components when using a
composable dual list selector.

components.name: DualListSelectorProps-deprecated
components.description:
Acts as a container for all other DualListSelector sub-components when using a
composable dual list selector.
